correctness.rationale: The first-order ODE gives Q_j=C(X^j-Z^j) by integrating over [t0,t1], with X=e^(-k(T-t1)) and Z=e^(-k(T-t0)). The ratios fix s=X+Z and delta^2=4Q3/Q1-3s^2=(X-Z)^2. A feasible interior triple is exactly Q1>0, delta>0 and e^(-kT)<(s-delta)/2<(s+delta)/2<1. Ordered roots, C=Q1/delta and the logarithmic endpoints reconstruct the readings uniquely. For either pair i<j of the three channels, set rho=Z/X and keep Q_j/Q_i fixed. The equation X^(j-i)=(Q_j/Q_i)(1-rho^i)/(1-rho^j) gives a continuous family for rho near its physical value, with C=Q_i/[X^i(1-rho^i)] fixing the common scale. All strict physical inequalities persist. Holding Q1,Q2 fixed gives dC/dQ3=-2/delta^3; normalization produces 2(1+rho+rho^2)/(1-rho)^2. The exact 6 follows from rho=e^(-kh) and 1-rho~kh. Direct factorization gives the frozen signed Jacobian in (C,X,Z), -C^2 delta^4; changing to (C,t0,t1) multiplies by -k^2 XZ. At the rational witness X=1/2,Z=1/4,C=4, delta=1/4 and Q3=7/16 give the relative sensitivity 14 exactly. The uploaded test was inspected but not run; these analytic checks suffice. All assertions are for calibrated exact data and a positive single interior rectangular pulse; no finite-noise or minimax claim follows.

evidence: From the twin-pulse passage, P=S^2-Q3/Q1 so (u-v)^2=S^2-4P=4Q3/Q1-3S^2. Then C=Q1/(u-v). Differentiating at fixed Q1,Q2 gives -2/(u-v)^3, and the relative factor is 2(S^2-P)/(u-v)^2. Writing v/u=e^(-kh) gives exactly the displayed duration law and its limit 6.
When only Q1,Q2 are read, S and C(u-v) are fixed and u-v can vary continuously under the same strict inequalities. The ordered-root inequalities also give the feasibility test directly.

originality.rationale: The decisive overlap is the established one-pulse equations in the distinct twin-pulse record, not the matching title, the date, or an inaccessible citation. Its Proof §1 gives the identical first three normalized observations in sum-product form. All of the exact single-pulse inverse, feasibility and conditioning calculations follow mechanically from those equations, including from their first three channels alone. The publications' within-day priority is not determined. The two documents are not identical (the other main finding is a four-channel discriminator), but the single-pulse mathematics considered here is covered by its explicit proof-level identities.
residual_risks: The reviewed record and the strongest distinct overlap have the same publication date; no within-day priority or attribution of discovery is inferred.
Hawker and Plonka–Tasche full texts and two deferred search results did not establish any additional coverage; unavailability does not drive the decision.

value.rationale: The motivating question is useful: a physically feasible inverse can still be very ill-conditioned for short pulses. Here, however, the exact inverse and its duration-only derivative are mechanical readings of the already explicit quadratic in the same data, with the constant 6 from a first-order exponential expansion. No distinct useful unknown invariant, independent bound, or design consequence survives the overlap. The one-model local derivative cannot be promoted to a general practical noise bound to supply that missing contribution.
